_comment: The model's category reaches the client as a LABEL (`result.draft.category`, and each `suggested_split` line), written by backend `category_matching.canonical_label` and read by frontend `labelNamesCategory` (components/ai/draftNotes.ts), which the AI Activity row and the editor's suggested split use to tell which category a label means. `cases` is run by BOTH backend/tests/unit/test_category_label_cases.py (the writer turns candidates[index] into `label`) and frontend/src/components/ai/draftNotes.test.ts (the reader says `label` names candidates[index] and no other candidate). A format changed on one side only fails on the other.

cases.label: Groceries
cases.note: a name that appears once is written bare

cases.label: Gifts (Holidays)
cases.note: a repeated name is qualified by its group

cases.label: Gifts (Household)
cases.note: each copy by its own group, never the bare name

cases.label: Gifts (Holidays)
cases.note: names that differ only in case repeat

cases.label: Garden – $150
cases.note: the real name, decoration and all, not the model's spelling of it
